title: Bitcoin Price Analysis: BTC at a Breaking Point as $63K Support Faces Critical Test
summary: Bitcoin’s November sell-off has extended, and it now trades around $64K, down roughly 14% over the past week. Rising expectations of a Fed rate hike, persistent spot ETF outflows, and a tech-stock slide ahead of Nvidia’s earnings have weighed on risk assets.
